title: Does DMPS (unithiol) help arsenicosis or mercury exposure?

grade.title: Small, uncontrolled, or single-source human evidence
grade.outcome: Arsenicosis symptoms or mercury urine levels
grade.basis: One small randomized trial and one uncontrolled occupational series.

answerHtml: One randomized trial of 21 adults with chronic arsenicosis reported an improved clinical score and higher urine arsenic with DMPS. An uncontrolled series in workers exposed to mercurous chloride reported higher urine mercury during treatment than off treatment. The number of workers was not stated in the abstract, so it is not given here. Neither study is a large replication.

sections.heading: Studies
sections.html:
DMPS studies in the evidence table.
StudyDesignResult
Guha Mazumder 2001 Placebo RCT, 11 versus 10 adults with chronic arsenicosis Improved clinical score and increased urine arsenic. doi:10.1081/clt-100108507. PMID 11778664.
Gonzalez-Ramirez 1998 Uncontrolled series, workers producing a mercurous chloride skin-bleaching lotion Urine mercury 1754, 314, and 173 µg/24 h on treatment versus 106, 48, and 53 µg/24 h off treatment. One worker stopped for intolerance. PMID 9765315. No DOI was listed.

sources.text: Guha Mazumder et al. 2001, doi:10.1081/clt-100108507, PMID 11778664
